scope: tenant-scoped SQLite token and call budget authority
Trusted Pi Sandbox request MAC and actual container identity binding
private Model Proxy HTTP gate with one durable provider dispatch fence
provider-safe adapter projection without tenant, project, user or capability claims

authority.aggregation: stable scope plus session plus turn plus generation; runtime dispatch recovery does not reset budget
authority.reservation: input token upper bound plus maximum output tokens
limits: input and output tokens per call
authority.dispatch: only the first durable reserved-to-dispatched transition authorizes provider execution
authority.unknown: holds the full reservation, blocks another active call and cannot authorize automatic replay
authority.usage: verified usage requires a provider request id; missing usage remains pending at the full bound
authority.policy: every request carries the capability-pinned policy version; changed configuration blocks new work
authority.integrity: turn key, call key, request digest, terminal digest, release digest, token total and timestamps are recomputed on read and replay

modelProxy.requestMac: HMAC-SHA-256 over container id, request time, capability digest and body digest
modelProxy.productionProvider: unconfigured; ModelProxyService returns 503 before budget reservation
modelProxy.replay: sequential and concurrent signed replay reaches the durable ledger but invokes the provider fixture once

closed: private HTTP route, request freshness, capability and actual container id are checked before the budget
capability budget policy version is enforced by the ledger
persisted derived keys, digests, token totals and future times fail closed
reservation attempts and dispatched calls have separate limits
deadline crossing creates a deterministic not-dispatched proof
idempotent reserve replay performs the same full persisted-record verification as lookup
provider adapters do not receive internal tenant, user, actor or capability claims
terminal evidence older than a recorded unknown observation cannot close reconciliation
concurrent replay creates one reservation row and one provider authorization
review.acceptedLimitation: transport replay is deduplicated by the tenant durable ledger rather than a second nonce store

notAccepted: production provider adapter, provider credentials or real model execution
Wrangler TenantModelBudget binding, SQLite migration or ModelProxyService binding
Workerd TenantModelBudget RPC and cloud Sandbox end-to-end validation
production capability issuance from ProductTurnRuntime release
streaming provider response and provider-side reconciliation query
prices, currency, balance, recharge, payment, refund or TenantBilling settlement
M2 staging deployment or enabling M2_TURNS_ENABLED
